description: Land Title Settlement Department - Minneriya, Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120136
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner information, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
